versions.subject: Merge PR #5500 from @swachchhanda000 - Potential Notepad++ CVE-2025-49144 Exploitation
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\regsvr32.exe'
    CommandLine|startswith: 'regsvr32 /s'
    CommandLine|contains: '\contextMenu\NppShell.dll'
filter_main_legit_regsvr32:
    Image:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\regsvr32.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\regsvr32.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
